conflicts.description: Reports differ on whether B2 phase deteriorates or improves room-temperature ductility in TiAl alloys; the present study concludes B2 phase is beneficial.

evidence.quote: Several works reported that the presence of the B2 phase in TiAl alloys deteriorated room temperature ductility [18,19], because it is a hard phase at room temperature. However, other works indicated that B2 phase containing TiAl alloys exhibited high room-temperature ductility [20].
